# AWS auth

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Assume an AWS role via GitHub OIDC, or fall back to static access keys

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/aws-auth@v1
  with:
    aws-region: # AWS region for the session.
```

## How it works

Authenticate to AWS, OIDC-first.

OIDC is the default and the documented path: the job exchanges its GitHub identity token
for short-lived STS credentials, so there is no long-lived access key in the repo at all.
It needs `permissions: id-token: write` on the job and a role whose trust policy accepts
`token.actions.githubusercontent.com` scoped to this repo — see docs/SECURITY.md for the
trust policy and the matching tf-tools module.

Static keys still work for the cases OIDC can't cover (a third-party account you don't
control the IAM of), but the action emits a warning so it never becomes the silent
default.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role-to-assume` | no | `""` | ARN of the role to assume via OIDC. Preferred over static keys. |
| `aws-region` | **yes** | — | AWS region for the session. |
| `role-session-name` | no | `""` | STS session name. Defaults to a run-identifying name. |
| `role-duration-seconds` | no | `3600` | Session lifetime. Keep it just longer than the job. |
| `role-external-id` | no | `""` | External ID, when the target role's trust policy requires one. |
| `aws-access-key-id` | no | `""` | Static access key. Only used when `role-to-assume` is empty. |
| `aws-secret-access-key` | no | `""` | Static secret key. Only used when `role-to-assume` is empty. |
| `aws-session-token` | no | `""` | Session token, for temporary static credentials. |
| `mask-account-id` | no | `true` | true to mask the account ID in logs. |
| `ecr-login` | no | `false` | true to also log Docker in to ECR in this account. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `account-id` | The authenticated AWS account ID (masked in logs when `mask-account-id`). |
| `ecr-registry` | ECR registry host (`<account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com`), when `ecr-login` ran. |
